start.prompt: work items / slugs from user message

spec.prompt: output path (Shinobu-owned; usually worktree specs/<slug>.json), task id, free text / task.original, pause path (Shinobu-owned; usually worktree current-task/specs/<slug>.pause.md); on re-spawn after questions, the same pause path plus the user's answers

gherkin.prompt: spec path (Shinobu-owned; usually worktree specs/<slug>.json), story output path (Shinobu-owned; usually worktree current-task/story.md); not chat / interview

archive.prompt: prefix (workspace or nested-project root), slug; archive_dir is always <prefix>/docs/archive/<slug>/; status/artifact paths or source_document; optional errors path; task id

sheep_return_contract.description: Every sheep ends with compact JSON. Shinobu forwards the return plus --step/--mode to sheep-status. Sheep do not name pipeline position — update-status derives next_step from routing, or from summary next_step when Shinobu supplies one (e.g. after review).

open_question_entry.description: A sheep cannot reach a human. When it needs an answer it stops and returns one entry per question; the caller renders them with its host's tool and re-spawns with the answers. No schema, no validator.
open_question_entry.question: required — what the sheep needs answered
open_question_entry.options: optional — short candidate answers so the caller can offer a choice
open_question_entry.context: optional — what the sheep found that raised the question

harness_failure.prompt: worktree path, failed script route, script input, expected output contract, actual failure context, blocked pipeline step

update-status.py.notes: Shinobu passes --step and --mode. next_step from routing, or summary next_step when Shinobu sets it. Position-only writes need summary next_step. Missing required field → written false.
